intro: Montview Acres is an acreage subdivision off Montview Drive in 78732, where larger lots sit close to Lake Travis. CleanzATX cleans windows here, and Tyler quotes by text.

sections.h2: What Montview Acres homes are like
paragraphs: Homes in Montview Acres sit on big lots rather than the tight lots of newer subdivisions. A typical sale price is around $1.65 million, and the neighborhood is small. There is no gate and no HOA listed. The breathing room between houses gives each one a private feel.
Large lots also mean long driveways and more landscaping. Plants, trees and stonework surround many of these homes, and the drive can be a good part of the cleaning list.

sections.h2: What Montview Acres windows deal with
paragraphs: On acreage there is more nature near the house. Trees drop leaf litter into screens and tracks, webs gather in corners, and cedar and live oak pollen stick to the glass in season. Dust from unpaved edges and nearby construction settles on sills.
Irrigation on larger lawns is a steady source of hard water. Sprinkler heads that reach windows leave white mineral marks, and over a few seasons the marks etch. Lake air nearby adds to it.

With a long driveway, we park near the house and run hose from our truck with 200 gallons of pure water on board. Poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so wide yards are no trouble. Many owners add driveway cleaning, since a long drive is where moss and dirt show most. We use a surface cleaner at $0.18 per square foot for concrete and $0.25 for pavers, with a $250 minimum. Stone and tile are soft washed.
Example: a 3,500 square foot house is about $350 for exterior windows, and the visit takes around three hours before any flatwork.

faq.q: Can you wash a long driveway in the same visit?
faq.a: Yes. Concrete is $0.18 per square foot and pavers are $0.25, with a $250 minimum. We use a surface cleaner on flat areas so the finish is even.

faq.q: Do large lots change your price?
faq.a: No. Windows are priced by count or house size, not lot size. A big lot just means a bit more walking, which we absorb.

faq.q: Why do my screens fill with leaves?
faq.a: Tree cover on acreage drops leaf litter that blows into screens. Cleaning screens is $5 each, and plans with a yearly free screen cleaning cover it.

faq.q: Is there a Montview Acres HOA to deal with?
faq.a: None that we know of, so you can book directly by text. If you are in a section with rules, mention them and we follow them.

faq.q: How often should I schedule windows on a wooded lot?
faq.a: Many wooded homes choose Quarterly at 15% off or Triannual at 15% off, which keeps pollen, webs and sprinkler spots from building up between visits.
